# Ho-Smart v0.2.0 — Cloud alarm history and Hybrid mode

**Focus:** Make real driveway alarm events available to Home Assistant after field testing showed that the HS006W's local receiver status did not expose usable live alarm events.

## Why this update was developed

Polling the physical HS006W receiver provided power, configuration, and armed-state information, but its local event fields did not reliably show driveway detections. This update added a separate Ho-Smart cloud alarm-history path rather than pretending that local state contained an alarm notification.

## What changed

- Added Hybrid, Local-only, and Cloud alarm connection modes.
- Added cloud alarm-history retrieval, driveway alarm entities, and Home Assistant alarm events.
- Added one-time Ho-Smart account onboarding for cloud mode without storing the account password or access tokens.
- Added channel-name matching, historical activity backfill, and cloud-related diagnostics.
- Reduced development local polling from four times per second to a five-second interval because faster reads did not reveal live alarms.

## Limitations and testing

**Cloud alarm delivery depends on Ho-Smart recording the event.** The HS006W's local status interface was not shown to provide an independent alarm stream, so Local-only mode should not be assumed to report driveway detections. This was the initial cloud-history implementation; later releases improved failure recovery and availability handling.

## Installation

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Select Hybrid mode for both receiver status and cloud history when configuring a supported HS006W.

**Full changelog:** [Compare v0.1.1...v0.2.0](https://github.com/gigabytegrove/hosmart-home-assistant/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0)
